title: Switch the markers
introduction: Invert a row of three stations: occupied becomes empty, empty becomes occupied.
explanation: if and else choose exactly one branch. beepersPresent() checks the current square. Pick up its coin when true; otherwise put one down. The else belongs to the original decision, even after the first branch changes the world.
objective: Toggle the coins on (2, 1), (3, 1) and (4, 1). Leave the start and exit empty. Finish at (5, 1), facing east, keeping all collected or unused coins.
instruction: Complete switchMarker() with if / else. Each station initially has zero or one coin. The bag starts with three coins.

commands.description: True when this square contains at least one coin.
Choose the pickup branch or the placement branch, never both.

hints: Use the same decision on all three stations.
Two separate if statements can undo your first action. Use else.
The true branch picks up; the else branch puts down.

illustration.alt: At each station, choose one branch: remove an existing gold coin or place one on an empty square. Never do both.
illustration.caption: At each station, choose one branch: remove an existing gold coin or place one on an empty square. Never do both.
